trait.calm_under_pressure: I usually stay composed and steady when things become stressful or uncertain.
trait.emotionally_steady: My mood tends to stay even; I do not swing rapidly between emotional highs and lows.
trait.highly_reactive: I feel emotions strongly and quickly; small events can produce large emotional responses.
trait.easily_upset: I am easily bothered or distressed by criticism, setbacks, or tense situations.
trait.quick_to_anger: I tend to become irritated or angry more quickly than most people.
trait.optimistic: I generally expect things to work out well and look for the positive side of situations.
trait.reliable_follow_through: When I say I will do something, I almost always follow through.
trait.organized_planner: I like to plan ahead and keep my responsibilities and surroundings in order.
trait.spontaneous_unstructured: I prefer to keep plans flexible and decide things in the moment rather than sticking to fixed schedules.
trait.detail_oriented: I notice and care about small details that many people overlook.
trait.disciplined: I can stick to routines and long-term goals even when motivation dips.
trait.ambitious: I have strong goals and push myself to achieve and improve over time.
trait.warm_and_affectionate: I naturally express warmth and affection toward people I care about.
trait.empathetic: I easily sense and feel what others are feeling and am moved by their experiences.
trait.supportive: People close to me generally find me a reliable source of emotional support.
trait.emotionally_reserved: I keep my feelings more private and do not readily show affection or strong emotion.
trait.compassionate: I feel a strong desire to help when I see someone suffering or in need.
trait.trusting: I tend to give people the benefit of the doubt and expect good intentions.
trait.assertive: I am comfortable stating my needs and opinions clearly, even when others disagree.
trait.accommodating: I often adjust my own preferences to keep harmony or meet others' needs.
trait.clear_boundaries: I am good at setting and maintaining personal boundaries with others.
trait.dominant_in_decisions: In joint decisions I tend to take the lead and push for my preferred direction.
trait.prefers_to_follow: I am often content to let someone else take the lead on plans and decisions.
trait.says_no_easily: I can say no to requests without feeling excessive guilt or needing long explanations.
trait.direct_communicator: I prefer to address issues head-on and say what I mean without much softening.
trait.diplomatic_softener: I carefully choose words to avoid unnecessary conflict or hurt feelings.
trait.conflict_avoidant: I go out of my way to avoid arguments or tense confrontations.
trait.patient: I can wait and stay calm when progress is slow or others are difficult.
trait.forgiving: I am able to let go of past hurts and move forward without holding lasting grudges.
trait.raises_issues_early: I tend to bring up small irritations before they grow into bigger problems.
trait.honest_direct: I value honesty highly and prefer to speak the truth even when it is uncomfortable.
trait.principled: I have strong personal principles and try to live by them consistently.
trait.fair_minded: I try to treat people impartially and consider different sides before judging.
trait.loyal: Once I commit to a person or cause, I stay steadfast through difficulties.
trait.transparent: I prefer to be open about my motives and feelings rather than strategic or hidden.
trait.self_reliant: I prefer to handle most things myself and do not easily ask for help.
trait.enjoys_interdependence: I like building a shared life where we rely on and support each other daily.
trait.needs_personal_space: I need a clear sense of personal space and autonomy even inside a close relationship.
trait.relationship_centered: My close relationships are a central source of meaning and priority in my life.
trait.maintains_separate_worlds: Even in a close relationship I keep distinct hobbies, friendships, or projects of my own.
trait.energized_by_people: Being around other people usually leaves me feeling more energetic and alive.
trait.needs_solitude: I need regular time alone to feel restored; too much social contact drains me.
trait.comfortable_in_groups: I feel at ease and can be myself in group settings and social gatherings.
trait.prefers_deep_one_on_one: I much prefer deep conversation with one or two people over large group interaction.
trait.initiates_plans: I am usually the one who suggests getting together or making social plans.
trait.curious_explorer: I am driven to explore new ideas, places, or experiences and get bored with too much routine.
trait.prefers_familiarity: I am most comfortable with familiar routines, known environments, and proven ways of doing things.
trait.intellectually_curious: I enjoy thinking about complex ideas and learning for its own sake.
trait.open_to_change: I adapt relatively easily when plans, environments, or expectations shift.
trait.open_to_feedback: I can hear constructive criticism without becoming defensive most of the time.
trait.playful: I enjoy teasing, joking, and bringing a light or playful spirit into interactions.
trait.humorous: I often notice and share the funny side of situations.
trait.serious_minded: I tend to approach life and conversations in a serious, earnest way.
trait.brings_levity: In tense or heavy moments I often try to lighten the mood.
trait.dry_humor: My sense of humor tends to be understated, ironic, or dry rather than loud or physical.
trait.meaning_seeking: I feel a strong need to understand the deeper purpose or significance of my life and choices.
trait.present_focused: I prefer to live in the moment and do not spend much time questioning the larger meaning of existence.
trait.mortality_aware: Awareness of life’s limits and impermanence often influences how I make decisions or set priorities.
trait.spiritually_oriented: I feel drawn to spiritual, philosophical, or transcendent questions beyond everyday practical concerns.
trait.secular_practical: I focus mainly on practical, this-world matters and am not strongly drawn to spiritual or ultimate questions.
trait.realistic_cautious: I tend to focus on practical risks and prefer not to assume the best outcome.
trait.recovers_quickly: After a setback or upset I tend to bounce back fairly quickly.
trait.ruminates: I often replay past events or worries in my mind long after they have happened.
trait.emotionally_self_aware: I can usually name what I am feeling and why while the feeling is still present.
trait.content_with_enough: I am satisfied with a moderate level of achievement and do not feel driven to constantly climb higher.
trait.deadline_driven: I work best when there is a clear deadline and can lose focus without one.
trait.procrastinates: I often put off starting or finishing tasks even when I know they matter.
trait.systems_oriented: I like creating systems, lists, or habits that make daily life run more smoothly.
trait.guarded_skeptical: I am cautious about trusting others until they have clearly earned it.
trait.physically_affectionate: I naturally express care through touch, closeness, or physical warmth.
trait.listens_deeply: When someone is talking I focus fully and try to understand before responding.
trait.emotionally_distant: I often keep an emotional distance even with people I care about.
trait.conflict_engaged: I am willing to stay in a difficult conversation until the issue is clearer.
trait.defers_to_others: In group or pair decisions I often let others take the lead rather than push my view.
trait.protective_of_time: I guard my time and energy and am selective about what I commit to.
trait.over_explains: When I set a limit I often feel the need to justify it at length.
trait.withdraws_under_stress: When tension rises I am more likely to pull away than to engage.
trait.apologizes_readily: I find it relatively easy to apologize when I have hurt or inconvenienced someone.
trait.keeps_score: I notice and remember imbalances in effort or fairness over time.
trait.seeks_clarity: In disagreements I push for clear understanding of what each person actually means.
trait.keeps_promises: When I make a commitment I treat it as binding even if circumstances become inconvenient.
trait.situational_ethics: I judge right and wrong partly by the specific situation rather than fixed rules alone.
trait.values_loyalty_highly: Loyalty from and to the people close to me is one of my highest priorities.
trait.challenges_unfairness: I speak up when I see something I consider unfair, even if it creates friction.
trait.private_about_values: I hold strong values but rarely discuss or display them unless asked.
trait.checks_in_often: In a close relationship I naturally want frequent contact and updates.
trait.shared_decision_maker: I prefer major life decisions to be made together rather than by one person alone.
trait.self_sufficient_emotionally: I can regulate my own mood and do not rely heavily on a partner to feel okay.
trait.merges_easily: I tend to blend my routines, plans, and preferences with a partner’s quite readily.
trait.enjoys_solo_time: I genuinely enjoy and look forward to stretches of time spent completely alone.
trait.talkative: In conversation I tend to speak more than I listen and enjoy keeping the talk going.
trait.selective_social: I am social with a small circle and prefer not to expand it much.
trait.enjoys_hosting: I like bringing people together and creating shared social experiences.
trait.low_key_presence: In groups I am content to be present without needing to perform or stand out.
trait.recharges_alone: After social time I need solitude to feel restored before I want more interaction.
trait.prefers_known_methods: I trust methods and ideas that have already been proven more than experimental ones.
trait.aesthetically_sensitive: I notice and care about beauty, atmosphere, or sensory quality in my surroundings.
trait.idea_oriented: I enjoy discussing abstract ideas, possibilities, and ‘what if’ scenarios.
trait.practical_thinker: I prefer concrete, useful thinking over abstract or theoretical discussion.
trait.loves_learning: I actively seek out new knowledge or skills even when there is no immediate practical need.
trait.prefers_serious_tone: I am more comfortable with serious or sincere conversation than with banter or silliness.
trait.spontaneous_fun: I am happy to drop plans or change direction if a more fun opportunity appears.
trait.teases_affectionately: I use light teasing as a way of showing fondness and creating connection.
trait.laughs_easily: I find humor in everyday situations and laugh more readily than many people.
trait.takes_things_literally: I often take statements at face value and can miss playful or sarcastic intent.
trait.experience_first: I learn and decide best by doing and experiencing things directly rather than by thinking them through first.
trait.savoring_the_moment: I actively try to notice and enjoy ordinary moments as they happen instead of rushing past them.
trait.adventure_oriented: I feel most alive when I am trying something new, uncertain, or physically engaging.
trait.embodied_living: I trust my body and senses as important guides for how to live, not only my thoughts or plans.
trait.light_on_planning: I prefer to keep life open and respond to what arises rather than mapping out a detailed long-term life plan.
trait.needs_reassurance: In close relationships I often need reassurance that my partner still cares about me.
trait.fears_abandonment: I sometimes worry that people I love will lose interest in me or leave.
trait.secure_in_partner: When a partner is busy or away, I can usually trust that our relationship is still fine.
trait.jealous_possessive: I feel jealous or uneasy when my partner spends close time with people I do not know well.
trait.comfortable_depending: I find it easy to depend on a partner and to let a partner depend on me.
trait.critical_of_partner: When something bothers me, I tend to point out what is wrong with the other person rather than the situation.
trait.sarcastic_when_upset: When I am frustrated I can become sarcastic, dismissive, or mocking.
trait.compromise_oriented: In disagreements I look for a middle ground that works for both of us.
trait.stubborn: Once I have taken a position it is hard for me to change it, even when given good reasons.
trait.holds_grudges: When someone hurts me, I find it hard to let it go, even after they apologize.
trait.expresses_appreciation: I regularly tell the people close to me what I appreciate about them.
trait.generous: I readily share my time, money, and attention with people I care about.
trait.thoughtful_gestures: I notice and remember small things that matter to others and act on them.
trait.shows_vulnerability: I am willing to show my fears and weaknesses to a partner.
trait.keeps_things_to_self: I usually keep worries or problems to myself rather than sharing them.
trait.humble: I do not see myself as more important or more deserving than other people.
trait.enjoys_status: Being admired, or having status and impressive things, matters a lot to me.
trait.bends_truth_for_harmony: I sometimes tell small untruths to avoid hurting feelings or awkward moments.
trait.self_confident: I generally feel confident and comfortable with who I am.
trait.self_conscious: I am often self-conscious about how other people see me.
trait.anxious_worrier: I worry a lot about things that could go wrong.
trait.hard_to_calm_down: Once I am upset, it takes me a long time to calm down.
trait.impulsive: I often act on impulses, such as buying things or making decisions, without thinking them through.
trait.decisive: I make decisions fairly quickly and stick with them.
trait.punctual: Being on time matters to me, and I expect the same from others.
trait.promises_slip: I sometimes agree to do things and then do not get around to doing them.
trait.competitive: I am strongly competitive, even in casual games or everyday situations.
trait.creative: I regularly make or express things creatively, for example art, music, writing, cooking, or design.
trait.unconventional: I am comfortable living differently from the social norms and expectations around me.

trait.partner_social_integration: I want my partner to become integrated into my existing social world.

trait.host_frequently: I enjoy having friends or family regularly visit our home.

trait.lifestyle_non_negotiable: Certain fundamental lifestyle differences would make a relationship unworkable for me.

trait.wants_pets: I want to share my home with pets.
